session.timestamp_interpretation: Timestamps treated as Cyprus-local based on observed session hours and prior workflow convention.

summary.headline: Near-term VIX body is being sold again while protection migrates into November-December and far-tail 50-60 strikes.
key_points: Session signed VIX delta is +13.809M, but excluding the AUG 16.5P/18P sale package it is approximately flat (-0.191M).
September 18-20 is again the dominant short-vol body; 22C remains the first preserved moderate-stress hedge.
The 11-Aug near-term 18.5-23 protection did not receive follow-through; November and December became the cleaner deferred risk bid.
October incremental flow is bearish VIX around 20, while 35 remains supply and 50C disaster insurance is bought.
For SPX the immediate regime is more comfortable than 11-Aug as long as front VIX stays below 16-17 and September below 18-20.
summary.daily_note: Near-term benign, deferred caution. Front and September body volatility are sold; moderate 22 stress is retained; new protection is pushed into November-December and 50-60 disaster tails.

leave_one_out.comment: Removing the largest single premium print does not change the near-term body-selling / deferred-hedge interpretation.
leave_one_out.directional_comment: Excluding the AUG 16.5P/18P sale package changes headline signed VIX delta from +13.809M to roughly flat (-0.191M), so the session-level directional sign is not broad consensus.
